package managers
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    ShapeLoader
    This class: - Loads Shape3D objects from a text file - Creates the correct shape type based on the file input - Stores all loaded shapes inside a ShapeRepository - Skips blank lines and comment lines beginning with '#'
    ShapeRepository
    This class: - Stores Shape3D objects inside a fixed‑size array - Tracks how many shapes have been added - Provides access to the stored shapes - Allows replacing the entire collection when needed
    ShapeResults
    This class: - Displays selected results from a sorted Shape3D array - Prints the first, last, and every 1000th element - Shows the comparison value used for sorting (height, volume, or surface area) - Reports the total runtime of the sorting algorithm
    SortController
    This class: - Selects which sorting algorithm to use - Calls the appropriate SortUtility method based on the user's input - Acts as a controller between the UI and the sorting logic
